LSE 0.5.9: a long-running server no longer runs out of GPU memory while memory it could give back is still cached, and long-context dMTP and DFlash2 decode is faster.

- macOS: needs mac_linuxgpu build 266 or later; the archive bundles the HSA runtime.
- Linux: needs the amdgpu kernel driver with KFD and access to `/dev/kfd`; the archive bundles the HSA runtime.

## Performance

Prefill, tok/s:

| GPU | OS | 256 | 1K | 2K | 4K | 32K |
| --- | --- | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| Radeon 8060S (gfx1151) | Linux | 461 | 498 | 511 | 515 | 475 |
| Radeon AI PRO R9700 | iPadOS (LemonSeed Studio) | 1,246 | 1,576 | 1,642 | 1,636 | 1,395 |
| Radeon AI PRO R9700 | Linux | 1,151 | 1,399 | 1,449 | 1,438 | 1,239 |
| Radeon AI PRO R9700 | macOS | 1,374 | 1,617 | 1,649 | 1,640 | 1,401 |

Decode, code prompt, tok/s:

| GPU | OS | Baseline | dMTP | DFlash2 |
| --- | --- | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| Radeon 8060S (gfx1151) | Linux | 14.0 | 48.0 | **68.0** |
| Radeon AI PRO R9700 | iPadOS (LemonSeed Studio) | 31.2 | 108.7 | **158.5** |
| Radeon AI PRO R9700 | Linux | 31.7 | 110.9 | **142.9** |
| Radeon AI PRO R9700 | macOS | 32.4 | 107.8 | **159.1** |

Model: Qwen3.8-27B, 4-bit (MLX); drafts: dMTP (dynamic MTP) 8-bit, DFlash2 8-bit.

## Changes

- Long-context decode: multi-row verify and dMTP draft attention read K/V once per key head. DFlash2 at 64K is 25% faster on the R9700.
- Cached device memory is released before an allocation that won't fit, instead of after a failure.
- HRX idle slabs are trimmed (macOS).
- Idle sessions are evicted under memory pressure.
- A refused allocation no longer kills the server, and the error states the requested, free and cached bytes.
- The K/V arenas are labelled as kv_cache in the memory report.
